system.description:
You take the attack head on in an attempt to lock the opponent in perfect targeting range, preventing them from dodging.

Immediately after you take the damage, you are able to cast 1 Bukijutsu with a casting time of 1 Action at no additional cost of B-Rank or lower. The target creature cannot take a Reaction until after this jutsu’s conclusion.

Chain 2: Increase the rank of the Jutsu you can cast to A-Rank.

Chain 3: You can cast up to two C-Rank Bukijutsu targeting the same creature.
